messages:
nick: dropping notes from the design sync — main asks: make presets discoverable but don't bury manual controls. prototype: presets above controls, collapsible. https://figma.redwood/proto/1742509999 :eyes:
hannah: i worry presets-first will hide the cost impact. need a small cost delta badge next to each preset (est. monthly delta)
priya: +1. also add an info microcopy under preset: 'Applies recommended slider values; review before apply.' avoids surprise
zack: keyboard/accessibility: presets list should be navigable via arrow keys and space to apply. announce with aria-live when applied
ari: pool picker: add type badges and an inline quick-filter. for large orgs the list is noisy — show 'recently used' at top
nick: steppers: implement adaptive stepper (+1 <10, +5 10	60, +10 >60). show tooltip on hover: 'step: +5'
hannah: burst wording tweak: replace 'burst minutes' with 'burst window (mins)'. include an inline example: 'e.g., +4 GPUs for 30 mins'
priya: guardrail language: softer tone: "This setting may approach your quota. Applying will request capacity and could affect billing." add a 'request increase' CTA when blocked
zack: simulate panel idea: right-rail summary showing quota ok (green/amber/red), est cost delta, and tail-latency impact. aria-live announce on value change
ari: mobile: collapse simulator into one-line summary with chevron to expand; make sure values are copyable for support tickets
design-bot: created update 1742510100 44d https://figma.redwood/flow/1742510100
priya: quick dev note: backend simulate payload example:
```
POST /api/v1/capacity/simulate
{
  "pool_id": "pool-22a",
  "min": 8,
  "max": 32,
  "burst_minutes": 30
}
```
response: {"estimated_cost_delta":"$24/mo","quota_ok":false,"tail_95_ms":180}
nick: A/B test question: we'd like flag for 'presets-visible-default' vs 'controls-visible-default' to measure apply rate and support tickets
hannah: tracking plan: instrument preset_impression, preset_apply, simulate_open, apply_click, undo_click. will add events
priya: accessibility follow-up: ensure color is not the only affordance for pool status and add text-first badges; screen reader should read pool type and available count
zack: undo snackbar after apply for 10s + link to activity log with exact settings changed
ari: microcopy suggestions: "Latency-first: prioritizes low tail latency by increasing min capacity." "Cost-optimized: lowers min and enables caching/batching." short and concrete
nick: thanks all. i'll update comps with cost badges, adaptive stepper, the simulator rail and the softer guardrail copy. design-bot please export a mobile frame too
design-bot: exported frames 1742510205-mobile + 1742510100-desktop :white_check_mark:
hannah: i'll prep the analytics events and funnel to check support ticket delta. closing thread after exports land :rocket:
